apps.name: Luma
apps.subtitle: Recovery, running, HYROX and fuelling from your WHOOP.
apps.localizedDescription: Luma reads a WHOOP strap you own directly over Bluetooth and turns it into recovery, sleep and strain each morning, GPS running with splits and spoken cues, HYROX race mode and readiness, a food and supplement log, and a coach. Your data stays on the phone; the coach runs on your own Anthropic key and reads only what you let it. A personal, non-commercial build on open-source foundations, credited in the app's About screen; not affiliated with WHOOP or HYROX.

versions.localizedDescription: Build 17. Your records are safe, and typing works. Fixed: Luma could be started by the strap while the phone was locked, find it could not open your records, take them for empty, ask for your details again and save over what you had logged. It now waits until it can read them and never saves over what it has not read. New: a copy of everything you log is kept for each of the last 14 days. Settings, Your data, Copies of your records: go back to a day if anything goes missing, and undo it if you change your mind. Typing: the box you are typing in stays above the keyboard, on the coach and in every form. Sending a message puts the keyboard away and the box goes back to one line. SkiErg, RowErg, BikeErg, runs and carries: a box for distance, time or calories when you check a workout read from a photo, when you add one by hand, and in a live session. No weight is asked for. The minus and plus buttons take the whole button, keep going while held, and a figure can be typed by tapping it (year, height, body mass). Fixed: removing a food item, a set or an exercise could stop the app. Data check now shows how your records were read and what iOS reports when the app stops.
